tools.name: compliance_check
tools.description:
Quick pre-publish compliance gate before generating a listing.

    Fast, free scan for obvious red-line words and category risks. Returns a shallow
    pass/fail-style result, not a full audit.

    Use this as a cheap pre-check right before generation. Do NOT use it for a complete risk
    report

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ai_readiness_check, generate_poa, analyze_review, fill_from_sentence · Private data: ai_readiness_check, compliance_scan, fill_from_sentence · Public sink: ai_readiness_check, compliance_check, compliance_scan, generate_poa, generate_listing.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ai_readiness_check, generate_poa, analyze_review, fill_from_sentence · Private data: ai_readiness_check, compliance_scan, fill_from_sentence · Public sink: ai_readiness_check, compliance_check, compliance_scan, generate_poa, generate_listing

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
